answer: Borrow the cuckoo rule from DHT research so clones cannot pack one jury. Seats sit on a ring cut into 40 juries of 50. Each new key lands at a VRF-random point, and every seat in a small hollow around it is kicked to fresh random spots. Join-quit re-rolling fails, because each try also scatters the farm's earlier aliases. Owning 17 seats of one jury then takes about a third of all 2,000 seats, ~650 keys instead of 17. Placement works like cast yarrow stalks: pure chance, so a stray ember of fakes never gathers into a fire.
